Recoil simulation ↓

Choose two weapons to compare; one is enough for its recoil simulation. Equal values and neutral traits keep their normal color.

No differences in the displayed stats.

Recoil simulation

Modelled kick, recovery, spread and camera shake (from the hip), standing still, with no mouse compensation. The plots are in the weapons’ kick units; the crosshair view is in degrees of view (upward exactly as the game does, sideways estimated), with each bullet’s hit and the spread circle.

A full magazine; with two weapons, as many shots as the smaller magazine holds, each at its own fire rate. Random samples use the same seed for comparison; they are not recorded game shots.

Recoil parameters are unavailable for this selection.
